label: VERIFIED
extraction: Team-based orchestration for agent squads using work items, ownership, agent Kanban, merge gates, and control pane handoffs. Agent Kanban columns: Backlog, Ready, Running, Review, Blocked, Merged, Archived with explicit exit criteria. Each card schema includes id, title, owner, state, branch, worktree, acceptance criteria, merge_gate, handoff path. 7-step flow: shape board, pick execution mode, assign boundaries, run agents, review in sequence, merge deliberately, extract reusable skill. Control pane requirements: active work items with Kanban state, owner/harness/branch/worktree/last heartbeat, links to handoff artifacts/tests/screenshots/PRs, blockers grouped by owner with unblock action, merge readiness by gate not vibes, reusable workflow candidates. Dynamic workflow compatibility: task-local harness under card owner, inputs/outputs on card, eval before Running to Review, promote to shared skill after repeat use. Failure modes: agent soup, invisible work, board theater, overlapping writes, no product artifact.
transfer_harness_fact: matches harness but specific transfer path not established
